lede: One Garage & Color is a car repair workshop at 8 Kaki Bukit Ave 4, #03-33, #03-14 & #04-50 Premier@Kaki Bukit Gate 2. Its Google Maps listing shows opening hours and customer ratings.
themes: Customers on Google Maps mention fast servicing by appointment, an alternator repair done within two hours at a reasonable charge, engine warning light checks and staff who make time to help with diagnostics.
